name: print-social-halftone-hills-ransom-note-portfolio-cover
title: Portfolio cover with ransom-note letters over halftone hills and a dock of app icons
whatItIs: A cover in blue-and-white halftone sky and green rolling hills reminiscent of an old desktop wallpaper. 'Portfolio' is spelled in mismatched multicolour letters cut out with black torn edges, with a blue scribble burst, a selected text box '2026', a name tape strip, and a macOS-style dock of creative app icons and a trash can at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Joyful and nostalgic; combining desktop culture and cut-and-paste zine style feels personal and fun.
techniques: Mix each letter in a different colour and face, with a black torn-paper backing.
Use a halftoned classic wallpaper landscape as the backdrop.
Include UI elements (selection box, cursor, dock) as illustration.
Label with tape strips in handwritten type.

vocabulary.definition: Letters in mixed styles and colours like a cut-out note.
A row of app icons like a computer dock.
A UI handle box drawn around an object as decoration.
